error_categories.description: The trace makes direct media-grounded claims about locating the introduction moment, identifying the relevant nameplate, and reading the text on it, but provides no tool-attributed evidence or textual support for any of those observations.

Even within the trace, the wording is internally unclear: it refers to 'Nick look at the nameplate to the rabbit's right' and then concludes the nameplate says 'Nick' without explaining why that name is on the rabbit's right-hand-side nameplate rather than being a separate character reference. The conclusion does not follow from the sparse text alone.

summary: The trace reaches a clear final conclusion ('Nick'), but in text-only mode it is unsupported because the key observations require unseen video/OCR evidence that is not provided or attributed to any tool result. The reasoning is also too thin and ambiguous to justify the chosen option from the trace text alone.
